_README: A hand-labelled set of cross-platform pairs, used to measure what the candidate
generator FINDS - not what the verifier does with what it is given.
The deployed diagnostic reports '109 pairs examined, 0 verified equivalent'.
That is a statement about the 109 pairs the generator proposed. It cannot
distinguish 'the venues list no equivalent contracts' from 'the generator did
not find the equivalent contracts that exist', and those have opposite
implications for what to work on.
equivalent   - a human reading both rule sets would trade one against the
other. The generator MUST propose these; missing one is a
near_miss    - same event, materially different settlement. The generator
SHOULD propose these so the verifier can reject them with a
stated reason; proposing them is correct behaviour.
false_friend - high surface similarity, unrelated or contradictory contract.
Proposing these is a precision cost, not an error, but a
generator that proposes only these has learned nothing.

pairs.why: Same underlying, same threshold, same instant, same index.
